row.team_price_text: Teams: $80/month for the team + $40/month per full seat (monthly)
row.evidence: The Devin pricing page (windsurf.com/pricing redirects there) lists SAML/OIDC SSO only on the "Let's talk" Enterprise plan, and the Windsurf/Devin Desktop SSO & SCIM guide says "This feature is only available to Enterprise users."
row.notes: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop (Cognition): windsurf.com/pricing redirects to devin.ai/pricing, and existing plans, including legacy Windsurf Enterprise, keep their pricing. Overlaps the existing 'codeium' row, which covers the same product (researched there as Devin/Cognition Platform); this row covers the Windsurf/Devin Desktop admin portal and its SCIM endpoint at https://server.codeium.com/scim/v2. Teams is $80/month for the team plus $40/month per full seat, up to 200 users, monthly price shown, no annual option. SSO and SCIM are Enterprise-only; SSO is no longer sold as a Teams add-on (legacy Teams SSO add-on customers keep it). SCIM is token-based (admin service key) and works with Okta and Entra through custom apps plus a documented SCIM API; SSO is not required for SCIM. Removing users via Entra disables them and frees the seat.

plans.name: Teams
plans.price_text: $80/month for team plan + $40/mo per full dev seat
plans.notes: Up to 200 users. Legacy Teams customers with the old SSO add-on keep SSO.

scim.notes: Some examples use https://<enterprise portal url>/_route/api_server/scim/v2 for enterprise portal deployments.

auth.token_source: windsurf.com/team/settings > Service Key Configuration > Add Service Key (role with Teams Read-Only, Teams Update, Teams Delete)

custom.how: Custom attributes cliActive (Devin CLI access) and acuCycleLimit (per-user ACU limit, mapped as a custom SCIM attribute in Okta or Entra); read-only effectiveAcuCycleLimit

limitations.text: Okta uses email as the unique user identifier; Okta push actions are Push New Users, Push Profile Updates and Push Groups.
Pushed groups are used for group analytics; User Groups need Enterprise with SCIM enabled.
With Entra, removing a user disables the account rather than deleting it.

endpoints.purpose: Team members with names, emails, last activity and credits used

rate_limits.text: Rate-limited; exceeding it returns 429 Too Many Requests (limit not published).

limitations.text: The non-SCIM Enterprise API is analytics and usage configuration; user lifecycle is done through the SCIM API.

okta.notes: No OIN app under Windsurf or Codeium; the vendor guide sets up a custom SAML app and enables SCIM on it with the generic endpoint.

entra.notes: No Windsurf/Codeium tutorial in the Entra SaaS-apps index; vendor guide uses a non-gallery app with the generic SCIM endpoint.

google.notes: Set up as a custom SAML app in Google Admin, not a catalogue app.
